## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the behaviour that changed
- [ ] New or changed components have a story, a test and an entry in `docs/design-system.md`
- [ ] A changeset is included (`pnpm changeset`) if a package changed
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour, setup or conventions changed
